fair_value_reason: FY28 (NTM at horizon) non-GAAP EPS ~$11.1 x 16x = ~$178. EPS runs from a ~$10.0-10.2 FY27 base: DC +$0.5, partial handset recovery +$0.3-0.5, pricing +$0.2 and buybacks +$0.2, less Apple -$0.25 and expected S27 loss -$0.2. The multiple is ~2.5 turns over the 2020-2025 realized forward mean (~13x) for the DC mix. Cross-check: normalized pre-SBC FCF ~$10/share on ~1.06B shares at 5.5% = ~$182; after SBC (~$3.2/share) at a 4% yield = ~$170. That is down from my round-1 $185, on the lower FY28 EPS (from $11.5). Share count ~1.08B before buybacks (Modular in, warrant ~0.5M net).

thesis_triggers.event: Below ~$125 (12x FY27 consensus, at the $121.99 52-week low, ~11x FY28 ~$11.1) the market would be pricing a failed data-center ramp (no Amazon revenue in the Dec quarter, FY27 well short of ~$5B, no further warrant tranches vesting), or a handset share loss beyond Apple (majority-Exynos S27 including Ultra) together with the memory slump running into 2028, taking FY28 EPS toward $9-9.5.

supervisor_summary: After round 2 the five forecasters agree on the facts and differ only in judgment: fair values $171-187 (mean ~$180), FY28 non-GAAP EPS $11.0-11.3, and 15.5-17x. I settle FY28 at ~$11.1: the memory-driven handset recovery lands only in early 2028, and a probability-weighted Samsung S27 share loss costs ~$0.2. At 16x, about 2.5 turns above QCOM's ~13x realized forward history, that gives a fair value of ~$178, slightly below the $184.5 spot. I do not shade further for the 27:3 revisions (the $10.20 mean has not moved in 30 days and agents already trimmed FY27), and I shift the ladder center only ~1.5% lower, with low confidence, so the mean ladder stands. The next test is the Q4 print and Q1 guide (Nov 4 expected, Nov 11 per aggregators), when the first Amazon data-center revenue shows up.
key_drivers: FY27 non-GAAP consensus is $10.20 (34 analysts), below FY26 $10.48. It fell from $10.96 after the July print and has been flat for 30 days despite 27 down / 3 up revisions. FY28 at ~$11.1 is the horizon earnings base.
Data center: ~$5B FY27 guided (Amazon revenue from the Dec quarter) toward $15B in FY29. The first hard check is the Q4 print and Q1 guide (Nov 4 expected); warrant tranche vesting tracks the ramp.

Handsets: the >$1.50 EPS memory-cost headwind recovers only from early 2028 on tracker data (Counterpoint, IDC, TrendForce), so most of it falls outside FY28's first half. Apple product revenue is <$2B in FY27 and heading to ~0.
Multiple: QCOM's realized forward non-GAAP P/E averaged ~13x in 2020-2025 (10.3-15.8x) vs ~18x today. A 16x horizon multiple still assumes the DC premium partly holds.
Samsung S27 (Feb 2027 launch) share falling from ~70-75% toward ~50% is a ~$0.3-0.45 EPS downside if confirmed; it is currently a single-broker estimate with conflicting follow-up reports.
